# Team

The person does these in the Whatsable app. Give the path and the steps; never say you did it. Fetch the "Full steps" address for the exact steps, or give the person the link.

## Invite a teammate

- **What it is:** Invite a teammate by email as Admin or Member; the invitation lasts 48 hours.
- **Plan:** Work, Growth, Pro, Agency and the 14-day trial.
- **Who can do it:** Owners and admins. An admin invites members only.
- **Where:** Team > Invite member
- **The agent can:** list the team and pending invitations with `list_members`
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/team-roles.md, section "invite-a-teammate". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/team-roles#invite-a-teammate

## Accept an invitation

- **What it is:** Join an organization from the invitation email, with a new or an existing account.
- **Plan:** Work, Growth, Pro, Agency and the 14-day trial.
- **Who can do it:** The person invited, from the email.
- **Where:** https://console.whatsable.app/accept-invitation > Accept invitation
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/get-started.md, section "join-a-team-from-an-invitation". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/get-started#join-a-team-from-an-invitation

## Roles: owner, admin and member

- **What it is:** Owner, Admin and Member, and what each can manage.
- **Plan:** Work, Growth, Pro, Agency and the 14-day trial.
- **Who can do it:** The owner manages admins and members. An admin manages members only.
- **Where:** Team
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/team-roles.md, section "the-three-roles". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/team-roles#the-three-roles

## Remove a teammate

- **What it is:** Take a teammate out of the organization.
- **Plan:** Work, Growth, Pro, Agency and the 14-day trial. Removing someone leaves an empty paid seat until the owner removes the seat.
- **Who can do it:** The owner removes anyone. An admin removes members.
- **Where:** Team
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/team-seats.md, section "remove-a-teammate". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/team-seats#remove-a-teammate

## Limit a member to some numbers or labels

- **What it is:** Limit a Member to some numbers, and to the conversations with some labels.
- **Plan:** Work, Growth, Pro, Agency and the 14-day trial.
- **Who can do it:** Owners and admins. Only members can be limited.
- **Where:** Team > Edit access
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/team-roles.md, section "limit-a-member-to-numbers-or-labels". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/team-roles#limit-a-member-to-numbers-or-labels
